name: Regenti Rebelia
source:
Adelia has never quite understood her place in the world—raised with lofty expectations and forced into a mold she's desperate to break. She often dreams of a different life of normalcy, self-expression, and a weight lifted off her shoulders. Two things stand in her way—her royal title and her overly protective personal knight.

Regenti Rebelia is a fantasy erotic otome, set in a world of royals and rebellions. The game follows a curious Princess on her quest to find herself and her identity, as she navigates peril and personal relationships.

[Edited from [url=https://lunamakaio.itch.io/regentirebelia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿德莉亚从来没有完全理解自己在这个世界上的地位——在崇高的期望下长大，却被迫陷入她渴望打破的模式。她经常梦想着一种不同的正常生活，自我表达，以及卸下肩上的重担。有两件事阻碍了她——她的皇室头衔和她过度保护的私人骑士。

《Regent Rebelia》是一款奇幻色情乙女游戏，背景设定在一个充满皇室和叛乱的世界。游戏讲述了一位好奇的公主在危险和人际关系中寻找自我和身份的故事。
